crownsfall.name: Mira Thorne
crownsfall.idle: Archivist of Crownsfall. 'Records do not lie, people do. Lately I am not sure which is which.'

crownsfall.name: Captain Ralden
crownsfall.idle: Captain of the city watch. 'Mira finds the questions. I keep the people who ask them alive.'

crownsfall.name: Quartermaster Ysolde
crownsfall.idle: Coin for steel, steel for coin.

bramblewatch.name: Rowan Hale
bramblewatch.idle: Scout of the courier roads. 'Every road out here used to go somewhere.'

mossbell_hamlet.name: Widow Ansel
mossbell_hamlet.idle: 'Three doors, three families, one missing girl. Everyone remembers her differently.'

bellwater_mills.name: Bera Flint
bellwater_mills.idle: Millwright of Bellwater. 'The water ran uphill for an hour. Then it remembered how not to.'

highward_steps.name: Marshal Garran Holt
highward_steps.idle: 'The Regent wants order. I want my people alive. Today those are the same thing.'

highward_steps.name: Highward Trader
highward_steps.idle: Coin for steel, steel for coin.

sablemarket_vaults.name: Tamsin Reed
sablemarket_vaults.idle: Keeper of Names. 'A name is not a claim to someone else's home.'

first_anchor_chamber.name: Joren Pike
first_anchor_chamber.idle: The missing royal courier. 'I was on the road. Then I was nowhere. Then I heard you say my route.'

crownsfall_citadel.name: Regent Maera Ashford
crownsfall_citadel.idle: 'I kept this city fed by keeping it calm. I may have kept it ignorant too.'

crownsfall_citadel.name: Crownsfall Trader
crownsfall_citadel.idle: Coin for steel, steel for coin.

westgate_refuge.name: Iri
westgate_refuge.idle: Veyr Phasewalker. 'The people the scars take are people. Say it with me.'

westgate_refuge.name: Westgate Trader
westgate_refuge.idle: Coin for steel, steel for coin.

veyr_meridian_outpost.name: Meridian
veyr_meridian_outpost.idle: Chief keeper of the Veyr. 'Records and models can be wrong. Mine included.'

veyr_meridian_outpost.name: Warden Sio
veyr_meridian_outpost.idle: Echo Warden of the Veyr. Supplies for those who cross.

greywake_coast.name: Captain Anwen Sable
greywake_coast.idle: Greywake pilot. 'The beacons kept ships alive. Now they keep something else away.'

meridian_observatory.name: Meridian
meridian_observatory.idle: 'Seven records, one pattern. The scars are periodic, not natural.'

aurelian_forum.name: Elyndor
aurelian_forum.idle: Aurelian historian. 'Deletion displaces records. It does not destroy them.'

aurelian_forum.name: Aurelian Trader
aurelian_forum.idle: Coin for steel, steel for coin.

workers_terrace.name: Daro Fen
workers_terrace.idle: Guild worker of the labour district. 'Who pays for eternity? Us. Always us.'

workers_terrace.name: Workers' Trader
workers_terrace.idle: Coin for steel, steel for coin.

concord_senate.name: Chancellor Valen Oris
concord_senate.idle: 'A civilization cannot survive as a collection of exceptions.'

concord_senate.name: Concord Trader
concord_senate.idle: Coin for steel, steel for coin.

vael_estate.name: Ser Caldrin Vael
vael_estate.idle: 'Stay behind me. The doors must hold. That is the job.'

vael_estate.name: Elara Vael
vael_estate.idle: Bookbinder and refuge organiser. 'Come home before the bell.'

preservation_laboratory.name: Sera Voss
preservation_laboratory.idle: Engine engineer. 'We can save people without saving every street.'

preservation_laboratory.name: Pell
preservation_laboratory.idle: Sera's technician. Keeps the logs, keeps the lights on.

remnant_court_refuge.name: Queen Ysara
remnant_court_refuge.idle: Sovereign of the Remnant Court. 'Restoring my people is not a request.'

keepers_lantern.name: Tamsin Reed
keepers_lantern.idle: 'The names that survived. Help me keep them that way.'

keepers_lantern.name: Lys Vael
keepers_lantern.idle: A young adult now, in the Between. 'I still have the paper crown.'

broken_meridian.name: Rowan Hale
broken_meridian.idle: 'Some mornings I'm not sure which road I grew up on.'

throne_of_glass.name: Queen Ysara
throne_of_glass.idle: 'You came to petition a queen without a kingdom. Speak.'

orchard_of_lost_children.name: Lys Vael
orchard_of_lost_children.idle: 'Every lantern is a child someone forgot. We are cataloguing them, one by one.'

the_regents_archive.name: Regent Maera Ashford
the_regents_archive.idle: 'A crown of borrowed stone. I suspected. I did not want to know.'

the_regents_archive.name: Mira Thorne
the_regents_archive.idle: 'The city is layered from forgotten lives. That makes it more ours, not less.'

hearth_of_names.name: Tamsin Reed
hearth_of_names.idle: 'The Covenant of Names: no record taken without consent.'

crownsfall_under_siege.name: Marshal Garran Holt
crownsfall_under_siege.idle: 'Citizens and Unwritten alike. Nobody gets left at the door.'

veyr_sanctuary.name: Meridian
veyr_sanctuary.idle: 'I concealed the warning. I was wrong. The clock is yours as much as ours.'

veyr_sanctuary.name: Iri
veyr_sanctuary.idle: 'Every faction is here. Try to keep them in one room.'

confluence_camp.name: Mira Thorne
confluence_camp.idle: 'Every faction. One table. Tell them what tomorrow costs.'

caldrins_vigil.name: Ser Caldrin Vael
caldrins_vigil.idle: 'I have stood at this door long enough. Let someone open it.'

the_last_decision.name: Tamsin Reed
the_last_decision.idle: 'A name is not a claim to someone else's home.'

the_last_decision.name: Mira Thorne
the_last_decision.idle: 'We can remember what was lost without becoming it.'

crownsfall_reborn.name: Mira Thorne
crownsfall_reborn.idle: 'After the bell. Let's see what kind of city we chose.'

crownsfall_reborn.name: Marshal Garran Holt
crownsfall_reborn.idle: Keeping order in a changed city.

saltmarrow.name: Harbourmaster Wenna
saltmarrow.idle: 'The tide still comes in, Wayfarer, even if the ships don't.'

wreckers_strand.name: Harbourmaster Wenna
wreckers_strand.idle: 'I came up the Strand myself. Bring me those lenses.'

smugglers_grotto.name: Tamsin Reed
smugglers_grotto.idle: Keeper of Names. 'A name is not a claim to someone else's home.'

oldwatch.name: Rowan Hale
oldwatch.idle: Scout of the courier roads. 'Every road out here used to go somewhere.'

crownsfall_of_three_ages.name: Mira Thorne
crownsfall_of_three_ages.idle: 'Three versions of one plaza. Read the stones with me.'

crownsfall_of_three_ages.name: Crownsfall Trader
crownsfall_of_three_ages.idle: Coin for steel, steel for coin.
